pins.name: BUTTON_BUILTIN
pins.label: GPIO0 (Button)
pins.notes:
Must be HIGH or floating for normal boot; LOW at boot enters flash/programming mode. No interrupt support. This board's onboard user button (BUTTON_BUILTIN / ESPECTRO_BUTTON_PIN_V3) — see pfodWeb NOTE above
BUTTON_BUILTIN / ESPECTRO_BUTTON_PIN_V3 — onboard programmable user button (see pfodWeb NOTE above)

pins.name: TX

pins.name: TX1

pins.name: RX

pins.name: GPIO15
pins.label: GPIO15 (Led active high)
pins.notes:
Must be LOW at boot (tied to GND via resistor on most boards). This board's onboard single-color LED (LED_BUILTIN / ESPECTRO_LED_PIN), active-high — see pfodWeb NOTE above
LED_BUILTIN / ESPECTRO_LED_PIN — onboard single-color LED, active-high by vendor library default (see pfodWeb NOTE above)

pins.name: GPIO16
pins.label: GPIO16
pins.notes: RTC-domain pin: no internal pull-up/down, no PWM, no interrupt support. Commonly wired to RST for deep-sleep wake

pins.name: A0
pins.label: A0 (GPIO17)
pins.notes: Analog input only (A0) — cannot be used for digital I/O or PWM. Native range is 0-1.0V on the bare chip; no on-board divider confirmed for this board — see pfodWeb NOTE above
